title: Customers Who Upgraded Their Loyalty Tier
description:
Find customers who were previously on the `'bronze'` tier and later moved to `'silver'`, `'gold'`, or `'platinum'`. Return each such customer once.

**Table: customer_tiers** — `id`, `customer_id`, `customer_name`, `tier`, `effective_date`

Output columns: `customer_id`, `customer_name`. Order by `customer_id`.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE customer_tiers (id INTEGER, customer_id INTEGER, customer_name VARCHAR, tier VARCHAR, effective_date DATE); INSERT INTO customer_tiers VALUES (1,1,'Alice','bronze','2023-01-01'),(2,1,'Alice','silver','2024-01-01'),(3,2,'Bob','bronze','2023-03-01'),(4,2,'Bob','gold','2024-03-01'),(5,3,'Charlie','silver','2023-06-01'),(6,3,'Charlie','bronze','2024-06-01'),(7,4,'Diana','bronze','2023-09-01'),(8,4,'Diana','bronze','2024-01-01'),(9,5,'Eve','silver','2023-01-01'),(10,5,'Eve','gold','2024-01-01'),(11,6,'Frank','bronze','2023-01-01'),(12,6,'Frank','platinum','2024-01-01');
solution_sql: WITH tier_changes AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_name, tier, effective_date, LAG(tier) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY effective_date) AS prev_tier FROM customer_tiers) SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, customer_name FROM tier_changes WHERE prev_tier = 'bronze' AND tier IN ('silver','gold','platinum') ORDER BY customer_id;

test_cases.description: Alice (bronze→silver), Bob (bronze→gold), Frank (bronze→platinum) upgraded from bronze; Charlie downgraded, Diana stayed bronze, Eve upgraded but not from bronze

hints: Use LAG(tier) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY effective_date) to get the previous tier for each record.
Filter WHERE prev_tier = 'bronze' AND tier IN ('silver','gold','platinum') to find upgrade transitions.
Use DISTINCT to return each customer once even if they upgraded multiple times.
explanation: LAG reveals each tier change in context. Alice: bronze → silver (prev_tier='bronze', tier='silver') ✓. Bob: bronze → gold ✓. Frank: bronze → platinum ✓. Charlie moved silver → bronze (downgrade, not an upgrade from bronze). Diana stayed bronze → bronze (same tier). Eve upgraded silver → gold but her previous tier was 'silver', not 'bronze'. Three customers qualify.
